]> 01/08/2026 7:07 More sunshine and snowmaking!.

We're kicking off the weekend with a bluebird day at Perisher! Expect sun and a top of 6 degrees, with north-westerly winds 15 to 20 km/h becoming light in the early afternoon.

It was a chilly night in-resort last night - the temp dipped to -9 degrees and it's currently only -8 degrees, making for a great night of snowmaking. We had 172 guns firing from 6:30pm and still going at time of writing, helping to top up the base with man-made snow off the back of our last snowfall. Please note, the best skiing and riding remain in the snowmaking areas, and coverage may be thin elsewhere.

The most recent snowfall allowed us to open up some more lifts and terrain. 36 lifts are scheduled to spin today, and the team are working hard behind the scenes to get more open as quickly as possible. Be sure to keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop. There will be 48 groomed runs for you to enjoy some sunny laps.

Around the resort today, Chicks Who Shred will be ripping around, and there's plenty of live music; Valley Animal Duo at Blue Cow, Will Clift at Jax Bar, and DJ Bolta at Mid-Station! Night Skiing and Boarding is also taking place after-dark on Front Valley, with a special fireworks show at 7:00pm.

The vibes are high with more snow in the forecast.... but for now, enjoy the sunshine!
